operator_frame.origin: same real tabletop origin as square_d2/routing_d2
operator_frame.yaw: z rotation, 0 means pen local +x points +forward

holder.description: RED marker holder sampled jointly with the pen, snapped to a 1-inch grid; operator places the holder at the snapped (holder_x, holder_y)

baseline_uniform.space: joint pen + holder (holder snapped to grid)

eval_heldout.note: downstream eval/heldout set; an INDEPENDENT Sobol stream (its own seed, not a continuation of mulligan_sobol) so eval starts are independent of training starts
eval_heldout.space: joint pen + holder (holder snapped to grid)

mulligan_sobol.space: joint pen + holder (holder snapped to grid)
